description: This file defines a struct 'CachedMessage' used for caching stream messages, along with extension methods for comparison operations related to stream messages within the Orleans streaming framework.

classes.name: CachedMessage
classes.description: A tightly packed structure representing a cached stream message, containing identifiers, sequence info, timestamps, and data segment.

classes.name: CachedMessageExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for comparing CachedMessage instances and stream identifiers.

methods.name: Compare
methods.description: Compares a CachedMessage with a StreamSequenceToken to determine their relative order based on sequence number and event index.

methods.name: CompareStreamId
methods.description: Checks if the CachedMessage's StreamId matches a given StreamId.
